page.overview:
What is Alolan Graveler?

Graveler has four arms which can curl up to its body to roll at any time. Above its eyes is a wide rock crest. Unlike its pre-evolved form, Graveler has feet.

Graveler live atop the mountains. When they roll down, it is nearly impossible for it to be stopped.

Graveler evolves from Geodude starting at level 25 and evolves into Golem if traded.

Graveler appears to be based on a or . It may also draw inspiration from of Hindu myths and legends. It may also be based on a yōkai known as the Tsuchikorobi, also called the "tumbling monster" that rolls down cliffs and squashes travelers in its way similar to a boulder.
